objective: The coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-26 on the selected direction of SETTLE-BOUND-20261126-001: test whether the round of a growth's last merge (the first round of the final trough of its counts) bounds the round at which a local reader's view settles, together with the largest-block bound, on a fresh held-out sample of six-knot census starts under both knot laws, and whether that round can be predicted from the start's map of joins. Frozen with the advisor's review before the held-out runs are read. Stop at a start the bound misses, or none.
status: Complete 2026-11-26 (refereed: R1 confirmed with fixes, no Block): on 2,000 six-knot starts held out from fitting, every start settling past the largest-block bound has its settling cut exactly 3 rounds after the last fall in births (5 with parents): 16 distinct late starts, 18 start-law outcomes; the combined bound follows from it and is weak; for starts that are not late the cut can come later.
title: The settling cut after the last fall in births
